segs.t: I'm sitting at about 70,000 US a month, which is cool.
What made you decide to want to work with me?
Did you see something online on YouTube or Instagram?
Following your journey really closely
over the last couple of months, I was like, this guy,
he's not gatekeeping.
You know, he's willing to share this information for free.
Imagine how much more information
I would get if I was paying you guys.
So that was sort of what made me comfortable enough
to join as a client.
What perspective from your side changed like an e-com,
you know, getting to know the MR stuff?
I really liked the fact that you guys
have the monthly reoccurring revenue,
looking at your ROAS, looking at what I'm spending
on Facebook ads, what I'm making back.

text: I'm sitting at about 70,000 US a month, which is cool. What made you decide to want to work with me? Did you see something online on YouTube or Instagram? Following your journey really closely over the last couple of months, I was like, this guy, he's not gatekeeping. You know, he's willing to share this information for free. Imagine how much more information I would get if I was paying you guys. So that was sort of what made me comfortable enough to join as a client. What perspective from your side changed like an e-com, you know, getting to know the MR stuff? I really liked the fact that you guys have the monthly reoccurring revenue, looking at your ROAS, looking at what I'm spending on Facebook ads, what I'm making back. And it wasn't something where I felt like I was building, you know, a brand where people are gonna wanna come back and you're gonna have that reoccurring sort of income from the same person. But I also do think you're patient enough to guide someone that's new with the resources and coaching and the playbook and things like that.
